programs=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL-prime-agent-luna6-medium-fresh0/frozen/held-out-reference/play/users/u040/system/state/workspace/programs')

source='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    height, width = len(out), len(out[0])
    for c in range(width):
        if out[height - 1][c] != 5:
            continue
        color = 0
        for r in range(height - 1, -1, -1):
            if out[r][c] != 0:
                color = out[r][c]
            elif color:
                out[r][c] = color
    return out
'''
